mapper.insert: insert into product (id, name, price, shop_id, purchase_num, product_intro,product_imgs, gmt_created, gmt_modified) values (#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{shopId}, #{purchaseNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{productIntro,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{productImgs,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(),now())
mapper.update:
update product set
name = #{name},
price = #{price},
purchase_num = #{purchaseNum},
product_intro = #{productIntro},
product_imgs = #{productImgs},
gmt_modified = now() where id = #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select id, name, price, purchase_num, product_intro,product_imgs, shop_id, (SELECT s.name FROM shop s WHERE s.id=product.shop_id) AS shop_name, gmt_created, gmt_modified from product where id = #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select id, name, price, purchase_num, product_intro,product_imgs, shop_id, (SELECT s.name FROM shop s WHERE s.id=product.shop_id) AS shop_name, gmt_created, gmt_modified from product

select id, name, price, purchase_num, product_intro,product_imgs, shop_id, (SELECT s.name FROM shop s WHERE s.id=product.shop_id) AS shop_name, gmt_created, gmt_modified from product
limit #{currentIndex},#{pageSize}
mapper.sql:
FROM product p JOIN shop s ON s.id=p.shop_id AND s.status='ACTIVE' JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM product_detail WHERE stock > 0 AND price > 0 GROUP BY product_id ) sku ON sku.product_id=p.id
LOCATE(#{keyword}, p.name) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id,p.name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.product_imgs,',',1)),''),'/images/default-product.png') AS mainImage, CAST(sku.min_price AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS price,p.purchase_num AS purchaseNum, p.shop_id AS shopId,s.name AS shopName
ORDER BY
sku.min_price ASC, sku.min_price DESC,
p.gmt_created DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
